text:
I took my son to Dental Gallery Dental Clinic.
The dentist gave advice and took X-rays to check the tooth roots before extracting two wisdom teeth. My son didn't feel much pain during the extraction; the dentist was very gentle. My husband and I waited on the sofas outside in one of the many beautifully decorated and clean relaxation areas. Drinking water was provided. When thinking of a dental clinic, think of Dental Gallery; you won't be disappointed.
